project_name: 33/11 kV Industrial Receiving Substation & Technical Building EPC Package

drawings.title: 33kV Single Line Diagram (Incoming & Outgoing Bays)
drawings.callout_text: 33kV Incomer Feeder No. 1 & 2: 3C x 400 sq.mm Aluminium (Al) Conductor, XLPE Insulated, Steel Wire Armored (SWA), PVC Sheath, Run in Precast Trench.

drawings.title: 33kV Single Line Diagram (Incoming & Outgoing Bays)
drawings.callout_text: 33kV GIS Incomer Circuit Breaker Bay: Rated Voltage 36kV, Rated Current 1250A, Symmetrical Fault Withstand Rating 25 kA for 1.0 second.

drawings.title: 11kV Single Line Diagram & Transformer Incomer
drawings.callout_text: 15/20 MVA 33/11kV Dyn11 Power Transformer No. 1: 11kV Star Neutral shown connected directly to station earth bus with copper ground bar (Solidly Earthed, No NGR cubicle or link depicted).

drawings.title: Substation Automation & Protection Relay Architecture
drawings.callout_text: Note 7: Protection relays shall be multi-dropped using shielded twisted pair Belden cable via RS-485 Modbus RTU serial bus (9600 baud) communicating to Remote Terminal Unit (RTU).

drawings.title: Outdoor Transformer Yard Cable Routing & GA Sections
drawings.callout_text: Cable Tray Detail A-A: 600mm Heavy-Duty Perforated Return Flange Cable Ladder fabricated from Hot-Dip Galvanized Mild Steel (HDGI) minimum coating thickness 85 microns.
